title: finance-legal-personal-todo
content:
Daily scratchpad — finance/legal personal to-dos
Owner: Ava Chen (personal working notes)
Last sync: 2026-03-03

Top priorities this week:
- [ ] Invoice QC: Acme Inc. INV-2026-014 (due 2026-03-07) — double-check PO match and billing contact. Contact: emily@acme.com, billing@acme-payments.com. Amount: $18,400. Verify GL code and project tag (proj: EDGE-optim).
- [ ] Contract redline: Vendor: DataSecure (SaaS security scanning) — NDA + SOW redlines due 2026-03-10. Need legal to confirm liability cap language (ask: parity with platform standard).
- [ ] Renewal reminders: Okta enterprise seats renewal window opens 2026-04-15 — estimate seat count and propose 10% buffer. Owner: Noah P.

Quick notes / context:
- INV-2026-014: vendor submitted late (2/28). Payment terms 30 days. Verify tax form on file (W-9). If missing, hold payment and ping vendor.
- DataSecure contract: CLA has unusual termination clause (30 days notice). I suggested 60 days in email thread. Sofia suggested we require data return cert on termination. Add to redline doc (see linked drive).
- Okta renewal: usage spike Q4 causes extra seats; get monthly MAU report from product. Talk to Jenna (IT) for actual seat count.

Checklist (detailed)
- [ ] Pull invoices for March AP run (AP run: 2026-03-09) — tag urgent vendors
- [ ] Confirm vendor tax docs for vendors > $10k (Acme, DataSecure, CloudNexus)
- [ ] Draft redline summary for DataSecure and send to Legal (deadline 3/10)
- [ ] Create renewal forecast spreadsheet for Okta + Zoom + SSO providers (due 3/20)
- [ ] Add follow-up calendar invites for contract review w/Legal (30 min)
- [ ] Update contract tracker row: DataSecure (status: reviewing)

Notes to self / outstanding Qs:
- Who owns CloudNexus contract? I think it's infra (ping Sam). Need to confirm whether purchase order was issued under Dedicated capacity budget or platform budget. If Dedicated, cost center 4202.
- Check if Acme invoice should be billed to marketing or product — Jira ticket FIN-3421 says product, but Slack thread suggests marketing — reconcile.
- Is there an auto-renew clause for Zoom? Last check said yes; need to confirm cancellation window.

Quick links:
- Contract redline doc: shared_drives/finance-and-legal/contracts/datatools/datasecure-redline-draft.docx
- AP schedule sheet: shared_drives/finance-and-legal/ap/ap-run-calendar-2026.xlsx
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-3421

Reminders (calendar):
- 2026-03-08: internal review of DataSecure redline (15 min)
- 2026-03-09: AP run prep deadline (end of day)
- 2026-03-10: send redline summary to Legal and Vendor

Random notes / fragments:
- Consider adding small clause for data deletion certification for vendors with access to logs
- Might propose a $5k escrow hold for new vendors until W-9 + insurance verified (chat with Noah before proposing)

End of scratchpad. Will clean up and move to shared folder when ready (status -> in_review).
